request.spec:
Show on each person their cut total: their cuts across every pool they are a member of, added
up (a pool that shows no cuts adds nothing). Show the sheet's cut total: everyone's added up.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
Show on each person their cut total: their cuts across every pool they are a member of, added
up (a pool that shows no cuts adds nothing). Show the sheet's cut total: everyone's added up.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as
you work; iterate until it passes. Change whatever the request needs across the app — its stored
data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
Each person's row now shows their cut total, and the sheet shows a cut total for everyone. All four acceptance tests pass.

**What changed:** only `src/main/frontend/src/app/features/people/people-list.ts`.
- **Per person (`person-cut-total`):** a new "Cut total" column adds up the person's cuts from every pool they're a member of. A pool that shows no cut (one that isn't balanced, or has no pot) adds nothing. Someone in no pool shows `0.00`.
- **Sheet total (`rollup-cut-total`):** a "Cuts in total" line next to the other sheet totals adds everyone's cut totals together.

It adds up the cuts the pools section already shows, so the totals always match the pool rows. For example, Ada's 0.51 + 0.34 = 0.85, and the sheet total is 2.02. The stored data, the server and the audit file needed no changes. The pool list already reloads whenever the sheet is loaded and whenever a member or the pot changes, so the totals stay current.

**Test runs:** in the first full `bin/e2e` run, three tests passed and "cut totals scenario 1" failed. The failing step was editing a claim (`editClaim` at line 213 of the spec), which this change doesn't touch. I couldn't see why, because that run saved no trace or screenshot. When I re-ran it on its own it passed, and two more full runs of all four tests also passed. So I believe that step is occasionally flaky rather than broken by this change, but I haven't confirmed the cause.
